model_output.verdict: An executive marketing resume with team budgets and business results attached to the work.
write_up: Your resume is strong: it follows your progression from marketing manager to Chief Marketing Officer, with the teams, budgets and business results at each step. The Novara work ties global strategy to lead growth, revenue and customer acquisition costs, giving a recruiter plenty to discuss.

The Viridian account-based marketing line is a great model. It names the program you built, its annual pipeline contribution and the change in win rates among Fortune 500 clients. The older roles have a couple of measures that need a definition, but the overall story is easy to follow.

Start by explaining how you measured channel sales effectiveness and sales productivity. Your resume is unlikely to be the thing standing between you and a call back; the competitiveness of the role and a referral can also matter.

cards.line: - I decided to establish a quarterly business review process with sales and product leadership that improved campaign alignment and delivered a 15% increase in channel sales effectiveness.
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can see the review process, but not what channel sales effectiveness measures. Naming the measure makes the 15% increase more useful.
cards.example: I decided to establish a quarterly business review process with sales and product leadership that improved campaign alignment and delivered a 15% increase in channel sales effectiveness, measured by [measure].
cards.question: How did you measure channel sales effectiveness?

cards.line: - I partnered with sales and channel teams to develop sales enablement tools, increasing sales productivity by 15%.
cards.cannot_tell: Sales productivity can mean several things, and the tools aren't named. A recruiter can't tell what the teams used or what improved.
cards.example: I partnered with sales and channel teams to develop [sales enablement tools], increasing sales productivity by 15% as measured by [measure].
cards.question: Which tools did you develop, and how was sales productivity measured?

cards.line: - I built and executed a comprehensive account-based marketing (ABM) program that increased pipeline contribution by $50M annually, lifting win rates by 15% among Fortune 500 clients.
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It gives a recruiter both the commercial measure and the customer group, so the figures have meaning.

cards.line: - I led a 45-person global marketing organization managing a $25M annual budget, driving company-wide brand and demand generation strategy for a SaaS platform serving 2M+ users across 40 countries.
cards.cannot_tell: For a broader executive role, a company-wide decision you helped make could show how your leadership reached beyond marketing.
cards.example: I led a 45-person global marketing organization managing a $25M annual budget, driving company-wide brand and demand generation strategy for a SaaS platform serving 2M+ users across 40 countries, and [your role in a company-wide decision].
cards.question: What company-wide decision did you help make, and what was your part in it?

fit.why: Your current Chief Marketing Officer role leads a global marketing organization and owns brand and demand generation strategy.
fit.level: executive, leads a 45-person global marketing organization and manages a $25M annual budget
fit.note: Your experience points toward executive marketing leadership in SaaS and other B2B technology businesses. The progression through strategy, global marketing and CMO roles is a coherent story.
